description.text: Premium Trainer Box VSTAR, released on 14 January 2022 with Star Birth, the expansion that brought the Pokémon VSTAR: 20 Star Birth packs and 191 cards of 38 kinds for building decks, among them two Mew and four Quick Ball, with a VSTAR marker to show the once-a-game VSTAR Power has been used. Acrylic damage counters, Poison and Burn markers, a damage counter case, a coin and a card box came with it.
